title: Drum Trainer
description: This dataset contains behavioral and EEG data from twenty-one participants who learned to perform two drumming sequences (AABA and AAABAA) at three tempos (60, 100, and 150 bpm) using keyboard responses. Trial-by-trial visual feedback indicated timing accuracy relative to an adaptive response window, allowing investigation of motor learning and timing control. The dataset includes detailed event coding for stimulus conditions and feedback types across trials.
methods_description: Participants performed drumming sequences by pressing the 'f' and 'j' keys in response to a fixation dot, followed by a 50 ms visual feedback circle indicating whether their response was early, on time, or late relative to an adaptive timing window. Task conditions varied by tempo (fast, medium, slow), pattern (1 or 2), and starting hand (left or right). EEG and behavioral event data were recorded with trigger codes encoding condition and feedback type.
